title: Settings Surface Shared State Model
description: Why settings surface uses module-scope state instead of prop threading or context.
body: A module rather than a prop threaded through WindowRoot, and rather than a context. The two halves mount independently and neither is the other's parent. A Set of subscribers rather than one callback: both windows of a detached pair mount their own screen, and a second subscriber replacing the first would leave one of them unable to close.
